column3: Settled in the pack early - drifted right approaching the final bend - closed strongly into contention - challenged into the last furlong - got up close home to score

Went straight to front - dropped to second early on - tucked in behind pace and shut for room approaching 2f out - shifted right with a furlong left - found extra to hit the front inside the closing furlong after edging left - caught close home - held second by a short margin
Handy early - driven to the front a furlong out - jostled when overtaken inside the final furlong - faded near the line to finish third
Nudged forward early - hit front after 1f - driven approaching 2f out before losing command inside final furlong - weakened late to finish fourth
Sat close to the front group early - pressed into action with 2f left before drifting right and slipping back on the turn - stayed on down the inside in the closing stages to finish 5th
Settled at the back early - work needed when driven approaching the final furlong - responded to close strongly late to finish sixth
Settled with the pack early - pushed for effort with over 2f remaining - unable to close the gap - finished 7th beaten 5 lengths
Settled towards the back early - unable to land a blow through the contest - finished well behind in 8th
Held up in the pack early - urged forward with over 2f left - lost ground and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 9th beaten 6 lengths
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed for effort - lost ground inside final furlong - finished well beaten in 10th
Settled with strong enthusiasm early - sat close behind pacesetter - moved to front beyond 2f out - drifted left approaching final furlong - stayed on well under pressure to score
Went clear early - lost front spot inside final two furlongs then fought back - stayed on to finish second beaten a length and a quarter
Positioned behind front group early - moved left with a furlong remaining - improved into third and stayed on strongly inside the final furlong - finished 3rd beaten 3 lengths
Fought the bridle early - settled midfield - made progress into contention over 2f out - dropped away in the closing stages to finish fourth
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - crept forward wide of rivals approaching final furlongs but unable to threaten leaders
Handy in the early stages - driven approaching 2f out - dropped away inside final furlong to finish 6th
Slow to break - settled towards the back of the pack - unable to make headway inside final 2f - finished seventh beaten just under 10 lengths
Sat close to the pace early - dropped away 3f out - trailed home in the closing stages
Fought for control early before dropping to the back - improved position 3f from home - dropped away 2f out and well held at the finish
Settled midfield early - urged along with 2f left - made gradual progress from a furlong out - edged ahead inside the final furlong - drew clear to the line - won going away
Set the pace early - driven approaching final 2f - lost front spot inside last - unable to quicken and beaten into second
Sat close to the front pair - travelling well with two furlongs left - pressed for effort a furlong out and moved into third inside the last - stayed on to finish third
Prominent early - driven and unable to quicken over a furlong out - stayed on steadily to finish fourth beaten 3.75 lengths
Settled towards the back - unable to land a blow through the contest - finished 5th
Settled at the back early - pushed for effort inside final 2f - unable to threaten leaders - finished sixth beaten 5.5 lengths
Held a spot around midpack early - pushed along with two out but couldn't land a blow - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish seventh
Settled in the front rank early - pushed for effort with over 2f left - lost ground steadily from the final furlong-and-a-half - well held at the finish
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed along with 2f left - no impression made through to the line
Set the pace from the off - pushed along with two to run - drifted left soon after - stayed on strongly through the closing stages to score
Slow to break - tracked front group - asked for effort 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong but couldn't threaten winner and faded close home
Tracked the front group early - urged forward approaching 2f out then lost ground with a furlong left - eased across left inside the final furlong - stayed on to the line finishing third
Held up towards the back - moved through from outside inside the final two furlongs and threatened the podium spot for a moment - but couldn't find more and faded to finish fourth
Tracked the front group early - squeezed for space with a furlong left - stayed on at an even effort through the closing stages - finished fifth beaten 4 lengths
Hesitant leaving stalls - held towards back of the pack - pushed along a furlong out - stayed on inside the final furlong without threatening
Held a forward position early - pushed along a furlong out - unable to find more in the closing stages finishing 7th beaten 4½ lengths
Settled with the pack early - driven for effort inside the final two furlongs - squeezed for space and dropped back approaching the last furlong - unable to recover late
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 3f left - couldn't land a blow - finished 9th
Held up towards the back - pushed along to make progress over 2f out - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished 10th
Held up towards the back - improved into contention over 2f out - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished 11th
Dwelt badly at the off - drifted left and shipped a big deficit - never a factor thereafter - well held in 12th
Settled early towards the front - pushed along to close in over a furlong out - hit the front inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to the line
Pulled hard in front - pressed on over 1f out - surrendered the lead inside the final furlong - flattened out to go down by half a length
Wide throughout early on - progress made into contention over 2f out - up to third with a furlong left - kept on to finish 3rd
Handy early - driven with two furlongs left and made gradual gains but couldn't reach the front pair a furlong out - stayed on at one speed to finish fourth
Tardy start - pulled hard towards the middle of the field - pushed into contention approaching the final furlong - stayed on without threatening the front
Prominent early - driven to chase leaders 2f out but couldn't threaten - dropped away last furlong to finish 6th
Sat close to the front pack early - driven on 3f out then dropped away when asked for more 2f out - faded final furlong to finish seventh
Settled at the back under restraint - failed to land a blow - finished eighth beaten 5¼ lengths
Held up towards the back of the pack - pushed for effort with over 2f left - soon lost touch - finished 9th
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - never a threat to the front - finished 10th
Slightly hesitant start - settled just off the front group - stayed on strongly under the rail inside the final furlong - got up close home to score
Set the pace early - lost front spot approaching 3f out then regained advantage over 2f out - pushed along inside final furlong - caught close home to finish second by a nose
Held up early - progress unclear until inside final 2f - edged left and into contention - fought on to finish third half a length off
Settled just behind the front group early - pushed along and found extra out wide with a furlong left - in contention approaching the final furlong - stayed on to finish fourth beaten half a length
Race up with the pace early - tracking the front group - pushed along inside the final furlong with a shout of victory - unable to find more and held late
Settled at the back early - boxed in with two furlongs left - improved position approaching the furlong marker - squeezed for space again then unable to close - finished sixth beaten two lengths
Sluggish start - settled just off the front group - squeezed for space with 2f left - denied a smooth passage and shifted left inside the final furlong - unable to find more close home finishing 7th
Tracked the pace early - hit the front approaching 3f out - overtaken with 2f left and slipped back a furlong later - faded through the closing stages to finish eighth
Prominent early on the wide side - hit the front after 1f - pushed clear approaching the final furlong and stayed on to score
Settled behind the front pair early - up with the pace after 2f - driven on approaching 2f out to challenge in front - stayed on but couldn't reel in the winner inside the last
Drifted left at the off - among the leaders - pressed for effort over 2f out and stayed on at one gear from the final furlong to finish third
Settled at the back early - drifted wide rounding the turn with 2f left - drifted left approaching the furlong marker and edged into contention - kept on to finish fourth

Set the pace early - overtaken before the 1f marker and slipped back through the field by 2f - urged forward with 3f remaining - given further encouragement 2f out - unable to threaten the leading pair finishing fifth beaten 8.5 lengths
Fought for control racing through the pack - pressed for effort then lost place inside final furlong - finished 6th
Held up towards the back - never involved in the finish - beaten well before the end
Bumped at the off - settled in the pack - dropped away under pressure with 2f left and no impression thereafter
Pulled hard early - set the pace throughout - headed briefly under 1f out - drifted left in the closing stages and stuck on to win
slow to break - settled within range of the pack - progress on the outer with a furlong left - drifted left to move into second inside the last - held short of the leader at the finish
Settled towards the back and pulling hard early - progress building but boxed in from over a furlong out until inside the final stages - rallied late to snatch third late on
Up with the front-runner - pressed for the lead approaching final furlong before squeezed for room and allowed to coast home in 4th

Sat close behind the front group early on eager rein - squeezed for space with just over a furlong left and asked for more - couldn't find the response to challenge inside the closing furlong - finished fifth beaten a length and a half

Settled just off the pace - urged along 2f out - boxed in and stuck behind horses over 1f out - moved left to find space and made progress - forced a gap approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to get up close home

Settled towards the back of the pack early - asked for effort with 2f remaining - edged left but built strong momentum a furlong out - hit the front just inside the final furlong - caught close home for second

Settled at the back early - dropped further adrift soon after - much still needed when asked for effort 2f out - moved right and progressed inside the final furlong - stayed on strongly to finish third close up

Settled handy early behind the pace - lost touch with the front pair 2f out - driven and made ground approaching the furlong marker - closed on the front group entering the last - unable to find more and held for 4th
Made the running - pressed into the final furlong and gave way when passed - faded to finish 5th
Settled in the pack - boxed in with a furlong left before finding room to the right - finished strongly to close late gap
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early - sat close to the pace - pushed along over 2f out and briefly threatened a furlong later - unable to land a blow and dropped away close home
Sat close to the front pack from the wide side - urged forward with over 2f left then edged left approaching the final furlong - lost momentum and found room tight late finishing 8th
Held up at back - pushed for effort with 2f left - boxed in with a furlong to go before shifting left for room - dropped away inside final furlong to finish ninth
Settled midfield early - drifted left approaching the turn 2f out and slipped back through the field - faded from there to finish well held in 10th
Settled behind front pair - moved into second with 2f left - hit the front inside final furlong - drew away to score readily
Sluggish start - settled off the pace midfield - improved position wide from 2f out - into second inside final furlong but drifting right - unable to peg back winner
Sat close to the front pack - pushed along a furlong out before moving into third inside the last - stayed on to finish third
Sluggish start - held up at the back - made progress inside final 2f - up into fourth close home
Settled towards the back of the pack - found running blocked before angling left inside the final furlong - unable to land a blow thereafter - finished fifth
Travelled with plenty of enthusiasm early - in front until being overtaken with a furlong left - lost ground close home
Settled midfield - crept up wide two out but couldn't threaten leaders - lost place inside final furlong to finish seventh
Sat close to pace early - stayed in touch until past halfway of the closing stretch - dropped away over a furlong out - well held at the finish
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - never involved - finished 9th
Held up at the back throughout - never in contention - well beaten in 10th
Held a handy position early - lost pace with 4f left before being withdrawn from contention

Settled with strong grip early - close to pace - asked for room approaching 2f out - moved through strongly a furlong out - into second soon after - edged ahead inside final furlong then pushed to the front - stayed on strongly for the win
Handy early - pushed to front approaching 2f out - driven on inside final furlong - lost advantage close home and could not find more

Handy early - tracked front pair from 2f - driven approaching 2 out - drifted left yet moved into second inside final 2f - unable to sustain the run and gave up spot before finishing well held by leading pair
Wide early in the pack - asked for effort over 2f out - unable to close from the furlong marker and finished well held in 4th
Settled in the pack early - pushed into the front rank by the 2f mark - dropped back under pressure with 2f left - faded from there to finish fifth
Settled towards the back under pressure early - unable to threaten the leaders - finished 6th beaten 14½ lengths
Went straight to front - pressed for effort with over 2f left - lost place inside final furlong - well held at finish
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - never featured - finished eighth
Held up in the pack early - angled left and made ground inside final 2f - improved into second then edged in front near the line
Settled behind the front group early - hit the front and drifted left approaching the final furlong - pushed along inside the last - caught right at the line to finish second by a short head
Sat close to the pace - moved left approaching final furlong and knocked into entering it - stayed on for third
Settled towards the rear of the pack early - improved on the outer approaching the furlong marker - moved into fourth close home - stayed on to finish fourth
Sat close to pace early - urged forward with two furlongs left - lost ground inside final furlong - finished fifth
Set the pace in brisk fashion - overtaken inside the final furlong and knocked sideways entering it - held on for sixth without finding more
Sat close to the front - pressed for effort with 2f left - lost ground inside the final furlong - finished seventh
Held up early - never a threat - beaten off through - finished last of the group in 8th
Held up towards the back - never a threat - beaten 10.5 lengths in 9th
Handy behind the front pair - pushed to the front approaching final furlong - held on strongly to the line
Settled midfield early - improved into contention over 2f out and edged right approaching the final furlong - stayed on strongly to claim second close home
Settled towards the back early - lost touch and needed urging 3f out - rallied late to move into third close home - finished without closing further
Held handy position early - urged forward with over 2f remaining - stayed on at same rate through the closing furlong - finished 4th beaten 4.75 lengths
Held a central position early - dropped away 3f out and drifted right under pressure with a furlong left - kept going at a steady gait to the line - finished 5th beaten under 5 lengths
Prominent early - nudged in front approaching 3f out - locked together with rival into 2f out - pushed along and overtaken inside final furlong then dropped away
Set the pace early - lost front spot just before 3f out - shared advantage approaching 2f out - pushed along and overtaken inside final furlong - dropped away rapidly close home to finish seventh
Held handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away late - beaten well into 8th
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - pushed along with a furlong left then faded near the finish
Went forward eagerly early on - settled in behind the pace then eased back through the pack after 2f - asked for effort 2f out - hampered for space inside final furlong - faded finishing 10th
Went ahead early - quickly overtaken - settled towards the back of the pack - progress from over a furlong out with much ground to make up - finished powerfully to score right on the line

Handy in the early running - settled second - dropped a spot with two furlongs left - responded to urging and surged home in the last 110 yards to hit the front near the line - just caught in the closing yards to finish second

Handy early - soon in front and dictated a fast gallop - driven with just over a furlong left - given further urging inside final 110 yards - unable to find more once overtaken close home to finish third by half a length
Held up towards the back - went wide rounding the turn 2f out - closed on the front group inside the last before fading
Settled close to the pace - moved into second over 2f out and pressed the front-runner with a furlong left - faded fast inside the final 110 yards to finish fifth
Held a midpack position - urged for effort with two furlongs left - squeezed for space and boxed in close to home - lost ground late to finish sixth beaten 4 lengths
Held up in the pack early - dropped away over 1f out - well beaten at the finish
Dwelt at the start - dropped well behind early and soon isolated - closed to join the field before halfway - tight for space inside the final 110 yards - faded to finish 8th

Settled in the pack early - began to progress two furlongs out and moved into second with a furlong left - pushed along to close inside the final furlong - responded gamely to take command in the last 50 yards and score
Raced with plenty of enthusiasm early on - hit the front - driven on approaching final furlong - matched stride for stride and edged out close home
Sat behind the front group early - pushed to keep tabs with two furlongs left - finished strongly into third inside the last furlong - kept on to the line
Dwelt at the start - dropped to the rear throughout - angled left with ground to make up 2f out - began closing when asked over 1f out - stuck on strongly inside the final furlong to take 4th
Prominent early - pushed along over 2f out and unable to close on the pace - held no more inside final furlong
Sluggish start - settled towards the back - moved right and pushed along 2f out - made gradual progress inside the final furlong - stayed on without threatening finished 6th beaten 3¾ lengths
Held handy early - pressed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - well held at the finish
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward with 3f left - driven and faded inside final 2f - finished eighth beaten 13.5 lengths
Held up in the pack - driven wide 3f out - dropped away over 2f out - well held at the finish
Settled close to the pace early - moved up on the front group with 2f left - hit the front and stretched clear inside the final furlong - kept finding more to the line
Held up towards back - lost more ground before halfway - pushed along to close from 1f out - grabbed second close home but no match for winner
Urged forward early - settled towards back on wide line - improved through middle stages inside final two furlongs - moved into third close home - stayed on well to finish third
Settled third early - moved into second before halfway - drifted wide on the home turn and dropped back before fading in the closing stages
Sent to front early - pressed for effort when overtaken with a furlong left - dropped away in the closing stages to finish 5th
Hesitant start - back of the field early - progress into mid-division - travelling strongly with a shout 1f out - faded through the last furlong and a half
Settled in the front rank early - hit the front before the 1f marker - pushed forward with a furlong left - drew away inside the final furlong to score comfortably
Prominent early - driven approaching 2f out - moved into second inside final furlong and stayed on - unable to challenge winner
Settled in the pack - pushed along and made progress over 2f out - moved into third with a furlong to run - held effort to the line in third
Settled with the pack early - pressed on into contention 2f out - squeezed for space with a furlong to run - kept on to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - looking for space approaching 2f out - shifted right and still boxed in a furlong later - found room to finish and stayed on without threatening for the win
Held up mid-pack - pushed along and found a short-lived spurt 1f out - weakened inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Sat close to the front pack early - urged forward with two to go - lost touch under pressure inside the final furlong - finished seventh
Sent clear from the start - lost the advantage before the 1f mark and sat handy - pressed for effort 2f out before fading fast in the final furlong
Settled towards the back early - never involved with the pace - dropped away and finished ninth
Settled towards the back of the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left - urged on soon after - lost ground inside the final furlong to finish 10th
Held up in touch with the back markers - unable to challenge - well held at the finish
Set the pace from the off - opened up a strong advantage inside the final two furlongs - kept on under mild urging to score comfortably
Settled second early - went wide approaching two furlongs out - pushed along and stayed on inside final furlong but unable to challenge winner
Slow to break - settled at the back of the field - crept into contention inside the final furlong - grabbed third close home
Drifted right early - settled in third - asked for effort 2f out and driven inside final furlong - faded near the line to finish fourth
Jumped start awkwardly and unhurried into stride - settled towards back - lost touch with leaders 2f out - faded before the line to finish 5th
Set the pace from the off - pushed along with two furlongs left before edging away inside the final furlong - kept on to score unopposed
Up with the pace - ridden over 2f out - drifted left and unable to close over 1f out - kept on without troubling the winner
Handy early - lost ground with 3f left - into third late on and kept going to finish 3rd
Fought for control early - travelled in a handy spot - driven with two out and lost momentum inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Sluggish start - stayed off the pace at the back for the whole trip - finished well held in 5th
Poor start - anchored at rear throughout - never able to challenge - finished well held in 6th

Sluggish start - settled into third and moved smoothly through the race - edged right to move into second with 2f remaining - reeled in the pacesetter approaching the last furlong - kept finding under pressure to hit the front close home - got up to win

Made the running - controlled tempo in front - picked up the gallop 3f out - kicked away to open daylight 2f out - advantage narrowed approaching final furlong - overtaken close home and unable to fight back

Dwelt at the break - settled towards the back - urged into contention approaching 3f out - lost ground for pace 2f out - shifted wide and made progress inside the last two furlongs - drifted left but grabbed third close home before fading close to the line
Settled in second early - driven from 3f out then hampered and dropped back 2f out - faded in the final furlong to finish 4th
Held up at the back - urged forward with 4f left - shifted wide on the home turn - lost touch and dropped away inside the final furlong

Involved in the pace argument early - hit the front approaching the final 3f - pressed for effort over 2f out and opened a two-length gap with a furlong left - margin narrowed close home - had to dig deep and edged home
settled at the back - strong progress over 2f out to reach second - tracked the front runner inside the final furlong - stuck on gamely to the line - touched off by a short head
Settled towards the back early - shifted left and began closing steadily over 2f out - up to third with a furlong left - stayed on at one level to finish third
settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left but unable to close - kept going steadily inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Settled with the pack early - pressed for effort with over 2f left - unable to threaten the front end - finished 5th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with two furlongs left - couldn't find more when asked a furlong out - finished sixth well held
Shared front spot early - lost command approaching 3f out then drifted right to run apart from rivals - faded inside final furlong

Raced up with the pace wide of rivals early - slipped back and tracked the main group after a furlong then sent along to try and go with them - faded to the back before 2f out and had no more to offer
Held up handy in the early stages - driven approaching 3f out - dropped back over 2f out - faded in the closing stages to finish 9th
Handy early in the pack - driven up to challenge over 2f out - hit the front approaching the last furlong - powered away for an easy win
knocked at the break - settled towards the back - made progress out wide inside the last furlong - moved into second close home and stayed on well for 2nd
Went straight to front - overtaken nearing final furlong - stayed on but couldn't hold third close home
Drifted right early - settled mid-pack - looked unfurnished when asked for effort 2f out - rallied late to grab fourth close home
Drifted right and clipped neighbour at the break - settled in the pack - found extra pace inside final furlong and stayed on - ended up in fifth

drifted right at the off - settled up with the front pair and into second - urged forward 2f out and edged right approaching the final furlong - faded fast inside the last - finished sixth beaten 5 1/4 lengths
Held a central berth on the wide side - lost touch a furlong out - dropped away inside the last
Sat close to the pace - drifted wide rounding the turn two out - lost touch inside final furlong and faded late
Settled at back of field - unable to quicken with front group over 3f out - dropped away inside final furlong - well beaten in 9th
Held up towards the back early - unable to land a blow - dropped away inside final furlong - finished well held in 10th
Drifted right at the break - up with the pace before hitting the front after a furlong - roused with two furlongs left - pushed out approaching the final furlong - responded strongly to land the race

Grabbed strong contact early - hit the front then lost it after a furlong - stayed close up - urged forward with 2f left - driven in pursuit of the leader inside the final furlong - held on for second without gaining further ground
Settled towards the back showing eagerness early - lost touch with pace 3f out - urged forward under pressure - stayed on well from 1f out to move into third - finished third
Prominent early - pushed for effort with two furlongs left and drifted left approaching the final furlong - unable to find extra close home finishing fourth
Settled with the pack early - urged into a gradual advance 2f out then found little a furlong out - dropped away close home to finish fifth
Hampered leaving stalls - settled towards the back - unable to make an impression - finished sixth
Settled towards the back - lost touch and driven approaching 3f out - no impact from inside the final furlong - finished 7th
mid-pack early - pushed for effort with 2f left - dropped away inside final furlong - eventually finished eighth well beaten
Settled in the runner-up spot early - closed on the front-runner approaching the final two furlongs - hit the front inside the last - powered clear for the win
Went straight to front and dictated a fast gallop - challenged with 2f left - overtaken inside the last furlong under pressure - unable to find more and held second
Dwelt at the start - last of the field early - niggled into contention approaching final furlong - ran on strongly to grab third inside the final 110yds - no threat to the front two
Held up at the back - moved through to third 2f out - pressed inside final furlong before fading to finish fourth
Settled third early - lost touch and slipped towards the back inside the final two furlongs - trailed off through the closing stages - finished fifth

Settled early on - dropped back around 4f mark - crept back into contention with 3f left - travelling nicely behind pace-setters - pushed for effort 2f out - moved through to command inside final furlong - stayed on strongly to score
set the pace early - dropped back then regained control passing 3f out - asked for effort 2f out - a rival came calling - lost the advantage inside the final furlong - stayed on well to finish second
Prominent early - moved into second spot 3f out - driven approaching 2f out - eased back to third inside final furlong - stayed on late but short of speed to get closer - finished third
Settled with the group early - pushed for effort with 2f left - kept trying from inside the final furlong but couldn't land a serious blow - finished fourth
Sluggish start - settled at back pulling hard - unable to challenge from there - finished fifth
Settled towards the back - pushed for effort with over 2f left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish sixth

Fought hard against the bridle early - straight into the front rank and in command after a furlong - opened a big margin after 2f - drifted wide rounding the bend after 3f - gap shrinking by the 7f mark - caught and passed 3f out - driven but faltered fast with 2f left - well beaten through the final furlong
